853:t_18:8.en:
$$カツ$$
「F-fate... You mean... I'm going to die like that?」

853:t_18:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Hahaha, catch me if you caaan! But be sure to watch where you're goiing!」

853:t_19:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Please don't be so wary. Just enjoy the moment, $$ハマーン$$.」

853:t_19:6.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「You're right... Now that we've come this far, perhaps I needn't be so stiff.」

853:t_19:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's right. Why not make a fresh start, wear twin tails like you used to and cozy up to $$シャア$$?」

853:t_19:8.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「...It seems I must discipline an insolent robot first...」

853:t_19:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A-ah... Please don't be too rough with me...」

853:t_20:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「It's you, $$ＡＧ$$... I'm sorry to put you to this trouble.」

853:t_20:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Not at all... I'm satisfied just being allowed to be close to you like this, $$アムロ$$.」

853:t_20:6.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I'm not one of the cute girls you like.」

853:t_20:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「No, no... My dream is to collect your exploits into a book and publish it, $$アムロ$$.」

853:t_20:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's for entertainment, after all. I'll add a little embellishment. Just a little.」

853:t_20:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「For example, I'll turn that remark into, '$$アムロ・レイ$$, the machine fetishist, secretly wished to be a beautiful girl.'」

853:t_20:11.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So this is how a book of ridiculous stories about me takes shape...」

853:t_21:4.en:
$$シャア$$
「It's you, $$ＡＧ$$... I've put you to some trouble.」

853:t_21:6.en:
$$シャア$$
「Perhaps it's because I have no unnecessary titles and can concentrate on what's in front of me.」

853:t_21:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I see... You've cast off your doubts before the final battle.」

853:t_21:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This truly is '$$シャア$$'s Final Chapter'! Say that catchy phrase with me!」

853:t_21:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Even you can't let go quite that much... No, I suppose you can't...」

853:t_22:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So, has your relationship with $$クェス$$ progressed at all?」

853:t_22:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well... $$クェス$$ is under $$ブライト$$'s supervision. You can't make a move so easily.」

853:t_22:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If you'd like, I can prepare gadgets, both legal and illegal, to help you get close to $$クェス$$.」

853:t_22:9.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「I don't need anything like that.」

853:t_22:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What are you saying?! Are you one of those trendy 'herbivore men'?!」

853:t_22:11.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「That's not it. ...$$クェス$$ and the world are both going through so much that I need to think these things through.」

853:t_22:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're surprisingly mature... I sound like a middle schooler who's just discovered sex...」

853:t_23:4.en:
$$クェス$$
「Thank you, $$ＡＧ$$. It really does feel good to have someone congratulate me like this.」

853:t_23:5.en:
$$クェス$$
「I know! I'll go tell the Colonel, $$アムロ$$, $$ハサウェイ$$ and the others too!」

853:t_23:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... $$クェス$$... I still have all sorts of congratulatory rituals to perform...」

853:t_23:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well... It's all right. You must be very happy now, with people around you who'll celebrate with you.」

853:t_24:4.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「This is only the beginning. I'm going to become a man who surpasses both the Colonel and $$アムロ$$.」

853:t_24:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then you must work even harder to improve yourself.」

853:t_24:6.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「You don't have to tell me. I'll shoot down many more enemies, become $c's undisputed ace, and...」

853:t_24:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But after you keep fighting like that and the war ends, what do you intend to do?」

853:t_24:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If you mean to surpass those two as a man, you'll have to grow as a person too. Keep working at it, $$ギュネイ$$.」

853:t_24:10.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「You're right, but hearing it from you really pisses me off!」

853:t_24:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If you want to be an ace as a person too, you'll have to start by changing that attitude...」

853:t_25:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm not asking for a reaction, so you can stay just as you are.」

853:t_25:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now, I'll read out a congratulatory telegram from $$リリーナ・ドーリアン$$.」

853:t_25:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The prank was a huge success! I got a reaction out of you, $$ヒイロ$$.」

853:t_25:11.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Don't worry. It's what you call a prank.」

853:t_25:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「W-wait...! I'm already a thoroughly shocked-and-startled robot!」

853:t_25:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A-at least say, 'I'll kill you', before you do it!」

853:t_26:4.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Whenever you congratulate me, I feel suspicious before I feel happy...」

853:t_26:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's rude! In that case, I'll put an end to the celebration!」

853:t_26:6.en:
$$デュオ$$
「I'm joking! Don't take it seriously, $$ＡＧ$$!」

853:t_26:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I know. You're well known for your love of jokes, $$デュオ$$.」

853:t_26:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Your Grim Reaper quotes... They're as devastating as my collection of dimension jokes.」

853:t_26:9.en:
$$デュオ$$
「You bastard! Is that payback for what I said earlier?!」

853:t_26:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well... Let's get along, as a team of a Grim Reaper and a devil.」

853:t_26:11.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Sheesh... I can never tell how much you're serious and how much you're joking...」

853:t_27:4.en:
$$トロワ$$
「Congratulations...? They don't really suit me.」

853:t_27:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's not true. Everyone is born into this world with a blessing.」

853:t_27:6.en:
$$トロワ$$
「But I don't have a name, the first gift anyone should receive.」

853:t_27:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Of course you do. You have the fine name of $$トロワ・バートン$$.」
